note: MDC forest area south of West Plains. Twelve designated camping spots are scattered along the area's gravel roads: each is a small cleared pull-off in the oak woods beside the road, with no pad, table, toilet or water, and most fit one rig. The pinned spot is at the crossroads 300 m east of the White Ranch Lake road; the lake (a few acres, with a picnic area and gravel ramp) is 450 m off and not in view from any spot. Two more spots are on a separate tract off Highway 142, 8 km east. A privy is at the shooting range on the south-east side. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 12 MDC-designated camping spots (map symbols + GIS points), all padless roadside clearings in woods - kept with that caveat in the note. No horse camp. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands. Pin fine. Phone matches. No brochure exists.
flags: DESIGNATED POINTS: the page lists 'Individual Campsites' under Camping (no brochure is posted; the only camping text is the standard Rule 140). The 10/5/2026 map legend has 'Camping Area' and draws 12 symbols; GIS layer 27 has the same 12 points (5 'Primitive Camping Area', 7 'Designated Camping Area'), none of them at a parking lot - the lot rule does not arise.

WHAT IS ON THE GROUND - PADLESS ROADSIDE (kept with a caveat, per the 2026-11-09 rule): leaf-off imagery of the pin and six other points shows no built camp anywhere. Each point is a bare or grassy clearing roughly 10-20 m across at the road edge or on a short two-track, under open oak canopy; one frame shows two vehicles parked at such a spot on Trail 6-1. The pinned spot (36.55996,-91.84996) is a clearing about 12 x 15 m in the north-east corner of the gravel crossroads. Roads are single-lane gravel ('Improved Road' on the map), no ford, no posted limit or 4WD wording.
HORSE CAMP: none. Rule 130 as posted for this area: 'Equestrian use is allowed on roads open to vehicular traffic' - no horse camp or trailhead is marked and none of the points is equestrian-only.

SPLIT - NOT PROPOSED, OWNER'S CALL: the area is in two tracts. Ten points are on the main tract; two ('Primitive Camping Area' 36.52310,-91.76700 and 'Designated Camping Area' 36.52519,-91.76979) are on the separate east tract, entered from Highway 142 about 8 km east-south-east of the pin, with its own lot (36.52275,-91.76089). On imagery those two are a roadside clearing at the mouth of Trail 12 and another 330 m up it - the same one-rig pull-offs, not more than a single small lot each, so the split rule's threshold is not met. Nothing in the database within 3 km of them.

WATERFRONT - NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: White Ranch Lake is a few acres (pond size); the nearest camping point is the pin, 450 m east through woods. The gravel lot at the lake's ramp (36.55817,-91.85501) is a parking lot, not a camping point.
FACILITIES: the map shows one Privy, at the rifle and pistol range lot (about 36.529,-91.820), 4.5 km from the pin, and none at any camping spot; nothing written to facilities.
PIN: stored pin = GIS 'Designated Camping Area' point, in the clearing at the crossroads, the spot nearest the lake and picnic area. No move.
PHONE: stored 417-746-0291 matches the page's 'For more information call (417) 746-0291'.
DIRECTIONS: the stored note's driving directions were the page's own text; dropped from the note as the pin shows the place.
